title: RRB Group D 27 Nov 2025 Shift 1 - Mathematics - Discounts
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: A scheme like 'Buy 6, Get 4 Free' on the same kind of articles with the same MRP attracts a _____ % discount.
questions.explain: In a 'Buy 6, Get 4 Free' offer, the customer pays for 6 articles and gets a total of 10 articles (6 bought + 4 free). The discount given is equivalent to the price of the 4 free articles out of the 10 total articles. Discount % = $\frac{4}{10} \times 100\% = 40\%$.
questions.subject: Mathematics
